profile.headline: Principal Staff Software Engineer at TomTom
profile.summary: I have a natural curiosity and passion for technology especially in the software development world.  I enjoy working in a highly collaborative and energetic environment with others that are passionate about solving challenging technical problems.  In general I believe in working and playing hard and enjoying the challenges life brings with both.

positions.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on End-to-End HD Map Building

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform Engineering working with:
- Kafka (KafkaConnect)
- AWS (MSK, S3, ...)
- Terraform 
- Golang
- Kotlin

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Open Exchange (start-up subsidiary of Opendoor)
* Identifying and driving cross team initiatives to improve release confidence (feature flags, improved
testing structures, on-call processes, metrics collection and alerting).
* Present and champion work to improve architecture such as caching strategies and refactoring toward
microservices.
* Process improvement for planning/tracking work and fostering an agile environment.
* Mentoring and interviewing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
DevPlatform Team
* Backend development for prototyping alternative timeline approaches. 
* Use of internal Strato (Scala-like IDL) tools, Thrift and Scala.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / Technical Lead - MapStore
positions.description:
* Contributed to service based data store for serving geospatial data (Java, MySQL, Cassandra and
Thrift).
* Lead initial work for developing the next Geofences service to replace an existing system (Java,
Spring, Redis, MySql and Jersey).
* Drive refactoring efforts for performance improvements and breaking monolithic application
down.
* Introduce Agile practices and balance roll as Scrum Master for planning and prioritization.
* Active in the recruiting and interview training initiatives for the site.
* Mentoring junior engineers and interns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead - 3D Warehouse
positions.description:
Server Side:
* SaaS development for 3D Warehouse and Tekla server.
* Refactoring the system to provide a RESTful API.
* Dev/Ops work with AWS stack.
* Primary technologies Java, Spring, Memcached, Solr, Jetty and MySql.
Client Side:
* Development for the 3D Warehouse product.
* Google Closure framework for UI and automated testing development.

positions.title: Software Engineer Dev Manger/Lead
positions.description:
* Balanced HR and Team Lead responsibilities while developing ~80% of the time.
* Lead teams employing Agile principles, utilizing Scrum, Kanban, TDD, and Pair programming.
* Directed development efforts to improve server-side scalability and performance, addressing increased request rate coupled with customer data growth.
* Defined and begin SOA implementation to address aging code base.
* Collaborated with the “People Team” to improve and refine the hiring process for engineering.
* Full-stack development on SaaS web application (Java, Spring, Oracle Javascript).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Full stack development of SaaS maintenance scheduling web application (JSF, JUnit, Ajax, Javascript).
* SOA Repository Manager software package for company software asset reuse management.
* Developed Java executable jars using JDBC, web services and application specific libraries to convert and persist data from Oracle data sources.
* Implemented controls for mobile robotic platforms and multiple degree of freedom manipulators (Java, C, C++, C#, VB, Windows CE, QNX, Pthreads, PICC).
* Developed hardware and controls software for a distributed embedded security system and a  windows based control interface (Microprocessors, C, C#).

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead Mechanical Engineer for testing and development of Stronglink (mechanical device consisting of precision discrimination gear train and step-up transformer) Interrupted Transformer Subassembly and Monitor Circuit Subassembly.
* Lead Mechanical Engineer for design and development of MEMS Environmental Sensing Devices including System Flight Test implementation.
* Interfaced with Honeywell FM&T for Stronglink production and assembly.
* Coordinated Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) training for several interdepartmental organizations.
* Conducted vibration testing, .
* Developed emergency response tools and manipulator integration onto mobile platforms.
